name: SubSplat
definition: The core component, Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterizer (SPGR), which subdivides each grid-anchored primary Gaussian into fine-grained sub-pixel primitives through dedicated geometry and appearance features.
summary: SubSplat is a high-resolution novel-view synthesis method that subdivides primary Gaussians into sub-pixel primitives to restore structural density and fidelity from low-resolution inputs.
